caption:
Every solo business has the same leak: proposals that were sent, never answered, and never chased. Not because you don't care — because Monday starts and the work in front of you wins.

Claude Cowork can run a task on a schedule — daily, weekly or monthly — against a folder of your own files, and hand back a working spreadsheet. So point it at your proposals folder and let it do the remembering. You get a table with the stale ones flagged and a draft follow-up for each.

Honest limitation: it misreads amounts on scanned PDFs and it will mark a closed deal as open. Treat the output as a to-do list, not a source of truth. Two minutes of eyeballing, three emails sent, done before your coffee goes cold.

Save this if you have a proposal sitting unanswered right now. What's your longest unchased quote — a week, a month?

Follow @leverageai.daily — one AI workflow a day for people who run their own business.

slides.sub: A scheduled AI job that tells you who to follow up with every Monday.

slides.headline: Get it all in one folder.

body.t: Proposals, quotes, signed SOWs, and any client email you saved as PDF.
If it is not in the folder, it does not exist.
One folder beats a perfect system you never fill.

slides.headline: Write the job once.
slides.sub: Point Claude Cowork at the folder and save this as a recurring task.
slides.label: COPY THIS PROMPT
slides.code:
Read every file in /Proposals.
Build a table: client, amount, date
sent, last contact, status.
Flag anything sent over 10 days ago
with no reply.
For each flagged row, draft a 4-line
follow-up email in my voice.
Save Pipeline.xlsx and drafts.md.

body.t: Cowork can run a task daily, weekly or monthly and hand back a finished spreadsheet.
Start it at your desk, read the result on your phone.
It misreads amounts on scanned PDFs and it will confidently mark a closed deal as open.
Treat the table as a to-do list, not a source of truth.
